description: This Java source file defines the BOMServices class, which provides various services related to Bills of Materials (BOM) in a manufacturing context within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for calculating product depth, updating low-level codes, retrieving BOM trees, managing shipment packages, and handling product components.

classes.name: BOMServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for managing Bills of Materials, including depth calculation, low-level code updates, BOM tree retrieval, and shipment package management within the OFBiz manufacturing module.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum depth (low level code) of a product within BOMs, optionally filtered by BOM type.

methods.name: updateLowLevelCode
methods.description: Computes and updates the low level code for a product and its descendants, considering variants and BOM hierarchy.

methods.name: initLowLevelCode
methods.description: Initializes low level codes for all products based on BOM hierarchy, setting them to zero initially.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Finds a duplicate ancestor in BOM relationships to prevent circular references.

methods.name: getBOMTree
methods.description: Retrieves a configured BOM tree for a product, useful for breakdown and explosion operations.

methods.name: getManufacturingComponents
methods.description: Returns the list of manufacturing components for a product, including routing information.

methods.name: getNotAssembledComponents
methods.description: Returns components of a product that are not yet assembled.

methods.name: createShipmentPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment packages and their contents based on shipment data, grouping by box types.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Retrieves products in packages for a given product, considering BOM and packaging details.
